question_text: At the parking lot gate, what's the ratio of car traffic to pedestrian traffic? Are more cars coming through or more people walking?
answer_text: There was an equal amount of car traffic and pedestrian traffic at the parking lot gate on December 8, 2025.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'car_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Parking'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS count
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'car_exit'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Parking'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS count
}
WITH sum(count) AS total_car_traffic
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'person_entry'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Parking'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS count
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (e:Event {event_type: 'person_exit'})-[:DETECTED_BY]->(:Camera {camera_location: 'Parking'})
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e) AS count
}
WITH total_car_traffic, sum(count) AS total_person_traffic
RETURN total_car_traffic, total_person_traffic, 
       CASE 
         WHEN total_car_traffic > total_person_traffic THEN 'More cars'
         WHEN total_car_traffic < total_person_traffic THEN 'More people'
         ELSE 'Equal traffic'
       END AS comparison
